### Give It A New Name
Author: Nicki Koziarz
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-march-22-2018.html
Passage: Genesis 35:18
Points:
- Rachel labeled her newborn son Ben-oni to reflect the anguish and sorrow of her dying moments.
- Jacob chose instead to name him Benjamin, refusing to let the boy live under a title defined by grief.
- Enduring the loss of a loved one severely tests whether one can still find wellness of soul.
- God invites believers to view painful situations from His perspective and allow Him to redefine their seasons of grief.
- Just as Christ endured suffering to sit at God's right hand, God can transform tragedy into eternal purpose.

### Rachel's Last Son
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/rachels-last-son
Passage: Genesis 35:16-21
Points:
- Rachel's death in childbirth was a painful trial that nevertheless fulfilled her earlier prayer for another son.
- Jacob renamed the child Benjamin rather than Ben-oni to remember his beloved wife with hope rather than perpetual sorrow.
- The birth of Jacob's twelfth son provided tangible proof of God's covenant faithfulness to build Israel into a nation.
- God demonstrates His providence and mercy most clearly when circumstances seem darkest.
- Christians are called to actively look for God's grace and help others trust in Him during seasons of heartbreak.
